bounded repository structure.detail: six files and 100-500 lines per episode; evaluation family counts {'h1': 6, 'h2': 6, 'h3': 6, 'h4': 6}

development and evaluation separation.detail: 8 development, 24 primary evaluation, and 24 paired perturbation-audit episodes have distinct manifests

evaluator firewall.detail: policy-visible runs contain no truth roles, useful-action labels, oracle ranks, or conclusions

identifier label and order perturbation.detail: semantic first-route role and correctness preserved in 96/96 routed/ReAct paired runs

matched evidence and declared budgets.detail: fixed, ReAct-like, and SER use four calls/four artifacts; monolithic uses one bounded call over four artifacts

no real-model spending.detail: all calibration records identify deterministic mock conditions and zero declared monetary cost

opaque identifiers and source labels.detail: opaque unit paths contain no mechanism labels, answers, or evaluator-field names

purchased-artifact semantic scope.detail: every semantic call contains exactly the artifact or bounded batch selected by its recorded action

static-only action surface.detail: only bounded artifact inspection exists; no execution, mutation, network, fuzzing, GitLab, or IDS action is present
